basis: Individually inspected prepared matrix/vector numerical instruction spans, independently reviewed arithmetic order and original-ROM differential comparisons of complete nine-cell backing, dimension word, reference/scalar result, native numerical status and explicit timer-response check count. Numeric callees, evaluator reference rewriting and hardware timer scheduling are not included implicitly. Understanding is independent of whole-firmware completion.

ranges.scope: Matrix/vector reference classification, dimension table and fixed nine-cell storage helpers; add/subtract and scalar multiply/general divide/fraction-preferring divide; active-cell rounding/absolute/rational preparation/integer cleanup; zeroed temporary matrix product with early dimension update and delayed commit; full-backing transpose; explicit one/two/three-dimensional determinant and ordered adjugate inverse with partial cancellation states; vector dot/cross and iterative complex magnitude, including forced-success scalar error outputs; copy/product/classification helpers and exact timer poll placement. Scalar callees and physical interrupt servicing excluded.
Matrix/vector unary negation prepares literal minus one and invokes ordered scalar multiplication with per-cell cancellation; caller scratch allocation and scalar copy callee excluded

Prepared matrix square/cube wrapper executes one/two products against the caller-preserved original matrix, with immediate status exit and cumulative cancellation checks; reference preservation/slot allocation before this wrapper excluded
Scalar rounding adapter preserves the record twenty bytes after the current cell around display-round scratch use, restoring that observable backing record; rounding callee excluded

Prepared matrix REF/RREF admission dispatch and complete finite row-reduction helpers: active-cell marker/rational preparation; leading-position swaps; private absolute-valued pivot comparisons with restart and zero-candidate stop; fraction normalization and raw exponent-minus-eleven tiny-zero predicate; ordered cross-product forward elimination with full-nine-cell delayed commit; literal zero-column compression/recursive restoration; destructive row-prefix extraction and saved-pivot-preserving merge; ascending upper-coefficient elimination; fixed cell/row/full-backing copy helpers and every terminal timer poll. Canonical dimensions and scalar cells; physical interrupt service and scalar arithmetic callees excluded.
